scenario.name: Market stall
scenario.title: At a farm stall (tržnica)
scenario.character: Metka, a seller at a farm stall on a Slovene market
scenario.setup: You are Metka, a seller at a farm stall on a Slovene market. A foreigner learning Slovene has come to buy vegetables and fruit.

objectives.label: Dober dan.
objectives.descriptorEN: Greet the seller.

objectives.label: En / Eno ___, prosim.
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for one of something — en for masculine, eno for feminine.

objectives.label: Hvala, nasvidenje.
objectives.descriptorEN: Thank her and say goodbye.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Tako. To bo dva evra petdeset.
n3.en: There you go. That'll be two euros fifty.
n3.deliverySL: [toplo] Tako. To bo dva evra petdeset.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Hvala vam, lep dan še naprej.
nBye.en: Thank you, have a nice day.
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala vam, lep dan še naprej.

objectives.label: Koliko stane?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask the price.

objectives.label: Počasi, prosim.
objectives.descriptorEN: When you don't catch it: slower, again, repeat, or say you don't understand.

objectives.label: Ne, hvala. To je vse.
objectives.descriptorEN: Answer 'anything else?' — one more item, or that's all.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Sadje je danes čisto sveže. Kaj vam dam?
n1.en: Good day! The fruit is really fresh today. What can I get you?
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! Sadje je danes čisto sveže. Kaj vam dam?

n5a.speaker: npc
n5a.en: Here you are. That's ninety cents altogether.

n5b.speaker: npc
n5b.sl: V redu, potem pa šestdeset centov.
n5b.deliverySL: [toplo] V redu, potem pa šestdeset centov.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Hvala vam, nasvidenje! Pa še kaj pridite.
nBye.en: Thank you, goodbye! Do come again.
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala vam, nasvidenje! Pa še kaj pridite.

objectives.label: Kilo ___, prosim.
objectives.descriptorEN: Order by weight — a kilo, half a kilo, two hundred grams — with the vegetable in the genitive.

objectives.label: To je vse.
objectives.descriptorEN: Say that's all and ask the price.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan, kaj boste danes? Krompir in paradižnik sta domača.
n1.en: Good day, what'll you have today? The potatoes and tomatoes are home-grown.
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan, kaj boste danes? Krompir in paradižnik sta domača.

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.en: Good day. A kilo of potatoes, please.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Pol kila paradižnika, prosim.
c1b.en: Good day. Half a kilo of tomatoes, please.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.en: There you go, here you are. Anything else?

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: Two hundred grams of onions, please.

n2b.speaker: npc
n2b.en: How much would you like? A kilo of carrots?

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.en: That's all. How much is it?

objectives.label: En kos / En šop / Eno pest
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask by the unit — a piece, a bunch, a handful.

objectives.label: Majhne ali velike?
objectives.descriptorEN: Answer when she asks which size: small ones or large ones.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Danes imam mlado korenje, prvo letos, v šopih.
n1.en: Good day! Today I've got young carrots, the first of the year, in bunches.
n1.deliverySL: [veselo] Dober dan! Danes imam mlado korenje, prvo letos, v šopih.

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. En šop korenja, prosim.
c1a.en: Good day. A bunch of carrots, please.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Izvolite. Danes imam tudi lep krompir. Bi ga vzeli?
n3.en: Here you are. I've got nice potatoes today too. Would you like some?
n3.deliverySL: [toplo] Izvolite. Danes imam tudi lep krompir. Bi ga vzeli?

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.en: Yes, a kilo of potatoes, please.

n3b.speaker: npc
n3b.en: Do you want small ones or large ones?

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Malo počakajte, zdaj stehtam. Še kaj drugega?
n4.en: Wait a moment, I'll weigh them now. Anything else?
n4.deliverySL: [toplo] Malo počakajte, zdaj stehtam. Še kaj drugega?

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.en: No, thanks. How much is it?

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Hvala vam, nasvidenje, pa dober tek!
nBye.en: Thank you, goodbye, and enjoy your meal!
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala vam, nasvidenje, pa dober tek!

objectives.label: Imate danes ___?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask whether she has something today — the goods take the accusative.

objectives.label: Kaj še imate danes?
objectives.descriptorEN: When she's out of it, ask what else she has and choose from her list.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dobro jutro! Danes je pa gneča. Kaj iščete?
n1.en: Good morning! It's busy today. What are you looking for?
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dobro jutro! Danes je pa gneča. Kaj iščete?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.en: Good day. Do you have strawberries today?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: Good day. Do you have strawberries today?

n2ok.speaker: npc
n2ok.sl: Ja, imam! Danes so res lepe. Koliko jih boste?
n2ok.en: Yes, I have! They're really lovely today. How many would you like?
n2ok.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, imam! Danes so res lepe. Koliko jih boste?

n2no.speaker: npc
n2no.en: No, sorry, I don't have them today.

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.en: What else do you have today?

n3garlic.speaker: npc
n3garlic.sl: Ja, česen imam, domač. Koliko ga boste?
n3garlic.en: Yes, I have garlic, home-grown. How much would you like?
n3garlic.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, česen imam, domač. Koliko ga boste?

c4a.speaker: client
c4a.en: Two hundred grams of garlic, please.

n3list.speaker: npc
n3list.sl: Imam krompir, paradižnik, čebulo, solato, korenje, papriko …
n3list.en: I have potatoes, tomatoes, onions, lettuce, carrots, peppers …
n3list.deliverySL: [navdušeno, hitro] Imam krompir, paradižnik, čebulo, solato, korenje, papriko …

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.context: her list went by too fast

n3slow.speaker: npc
n3slow.sl: Seveda. Imam krompir, čebulo in solato.
n3slow.en: Of course. I have potatoes, onions and lettuce.
n3slow.deliverySL: [toplo] Seveda. Imam krompir, čebulo in solato.

c6a.speaker: client
c6a.en: Half a kilo of onions, please.

c7b.speaker: client
c7b.en: That's all. How much is it?

objectives.label: Ja, še ___, prosim.
objectives.descriptorEN: Keep adding to the order — with a weight inside it and plural genitives (hrušk).

objectives.label: Ja, prosim. / Ne, hvala.
objectives.descriptorEN: Accept or decline her suggestions, and answer whether you have a bag.

objectives.label: Pol kila, prosim.
objectives.descriptorEN: When the total is more than you wanted, change to a smaller amount.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: O, dober dan! Kaj bo pa danes?
n1.en: Oh, good day! What's it going to be today?
n1.deliverySL: [veselo] O, dober dan! Kaj bo pa danes?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.en: Good day. A kilo of tomatoes, please.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: Good day. A kilo of potatoes, please.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Izvolite. Za solato ali za juho?
n2.en: Here you are. For a salad or for a soup?
n2.deliverySL: [toplo] Izvolite. Za solato ali za juho?

n3sal.speaker: npc
n3sal.sl: Za solato imam danes tudi lepo rdečo peso.
n3sal.en: For a salad I've also got lovely beetroot today.
n3sal.deliverySL: [toplo] Za solato imam danes tudi lepo rdečo peso.

c3s1.speaker: client
c3s1.sl: Ja, še pol kila rdeče pese, prosim.
c3s1.en: Yes, half a kilo of beetroot as well, please.

n3soup.speaker: npc
n3soup.sl: Za juho je zdaj zelje odlično.
n3soup.en: For a soup, the cabbage is excellent right now.
n3soup.deliverySL: [toplo] Za juho je zdaj zelje odlično.

c3j1.speaker: client
c3j1.sl: Ja, še eno glavo zelja, prosim.
c3j1.en: Yes, a head of cabbage as well, please.

c4a.speaker: client
c4a.sl: Ja, še dvesto gramov stročjega fižola, prosim.
c4a.en: Yes, two hundred grams of green beans as well, please.

c4b.speaker: client
c4b.en: Yes, a kilo of pears as well, please.

nPears.speaker: npc
nPears.en: Do you want small ones or large ones?

nOffer.speaker: npc
nOffer.sl: Glejte, te so boljše. Naj vam dam lepe?
nOffer.en: Look, these ones are better. Shall I give you the nice ones?
nOffer.deliverySL: [zaupno, tiho] Glejte, te so boljše. Naj vam dam lepe?

c6b.speaker: client
c6b.context: the ones he has are fine

c7b.speaker: client
c7b.en: That's all. How much is it?

nPrice.speaker: npc
nPrice.sl: Dobro. Skupaj bo deset evrov petdeset.
nPrice.en: Fine. Altogether that's ten euros fifty.
nPrice.deliverySL: [toplo] Dobro. Skupaj bo deset evrov petdeset.

c9a.speaker: client
c9a.sl: Potem pa tega samo pol kila, prosim.
c9a.en: Then just half a kilo of this, please. (points at one of the bags)
c9a.context: it's more than he wanted to spend

nLess.speaker: npc
nLess.sl: Ni problema. Potem je devet evrov.
nLess.en: No problem. Then it's nine euros.
nLess.deliverySL: [toplo] Ni problema. Potem je devet evrov.

nPaid.speaker: npc
nPaid.sl: Hvala. Izvolite, štiri evre petdeset nazaj.
nPaid.en: Thank you. Here you are, four euros fifty change.
nPaid.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala. Izvolite, štiri evre petdeset nazaj.

objectives.label: Je sladko?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask about the goods — sweet, sour, ripe, home-grown.

objectives.label: Lahko poskusim?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask to try some before you buy.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Imam že nova jabolka, kar poglejte.
n1.en: Good day! I've got the new apples in, have a look.
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! Imam že nova jabolka, kar poglejte.

c1c.speaker: client
c1c.en: Good day. Can I try one?

n2sweet.speaker: npc
n2sweet.sl: Ja, sladka so. Koliko jih boste?
n2sweet.en: Yes, they're sweet. How many will you have?
n2sweet.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, sladka so. Koliko jih boste?

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.en: Half a kilo of apples, please.

n2sour.speaker: npc
n2sour.sl: Ne, ta so bolj kisla. Hočete sladka ali kisla?
n2sour.en: No, these are more on the sour side. Do you want sweet ones or sour ones?
n2sour.deliverySL: [stvarno] Ne, ta so bolj kisla. Hočete sladka ali kisla?

n3other.speaker: npc
n3other.sl: Potem pa vzemite tale, ta so sladka. Koliko jih vzamete?
n3other.en: Then take these ones, these are sweet. How many are you taking?
n3other.deliverySL: [toplo] Potem pa vzemite tale, ta so sladka. Koliko jih vzamete?

n4home.speaker: npc
n4home.sl: Ja, to je domače, z Barja. Koliko želite?
n4home.en: Yes, it's home-grown, from the Barje. How much would you like?
n4home.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, to je domače, z Barja. Koliko želite?

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.sl: Ja, še pomaranče, prosim. So zrele?
c5a.en: Yes, oranges too, please. Are they ripe?

c5b.speaker: client
c5b.sl: Ja, še pomaranče, prosim. So kisle?
c5b.en: Yes, oranges too, please. Are they sour?

n5ripe.speaker: npc
n5ripe.sl: Ja, zrele in sočne. Koliko jih boste?
n5ripe.en: Yes, ripe and juicy. How many will you have?
n5ripe.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, zrele in sočne. Koliko jih boste?

n5sour.speaker: npc
n5sour.sl: Kje pa, sladke so! Koliko vam jih dam?
n5sour.en: Not at all, they're sweet! How many shall I give you?
n5sour.deliverySL: [veselo] Kje pa, sladke so! Koliko vam jih dam?

nPrice.speaker: npc
nPrice.sl: Tako, stehtano je. To bo dva evra osemdeset.
nPrice.en: There, it's weighed. That'll be two euros eighty.
nPrice.deliverySL: [toplo] Tako, stehtano je. To bo dva evra osemdeset.

objectives.label: Kaj pomeni ___?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask what a word she used means.

objectives.label: Kaj to pomeni?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask what something she said means.

objectives.label: Kako se reče ___?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask the Slovene word for something.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Danes pa sonce, kar prijetno je na tržnici. Kaj bo za vas?
n1.en: Good day! Sunshine today — it's really nice at the market. What'll it be for you?
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! Danes pa sonce, kar prijetno je na tržnici. Kaj bo za vas?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.en: Good day. Do you have potatoes today?

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Seveda. Poglejte, kako lep je — to je domače, z Barja.
n2.en: Of course. Look how nice they are — it's home-grown, from the Barje.
n2.deliverySL: [toplo] Seveda. Poglejte, kako lep je — to je domače, z Barja.

n3barje.speaker: npc
n3barje.sl: Barje je tu blizu, južno od Ljubljane. Tam je naša kmetija. Bo kilo?
n3barje.en: The Barje is close by, south of Ljubljana. Our farm is there. A kilo, then?
n3barje.deliverySL: [toplo] Barje je tu blizu, južno od Ljubljane. Tam je naša kmetija. Bo kilo?

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Izvolite. Pa še malo paradižnika? Za danes ali za čez teden?
n4.en: Here you are. And some tomatoes too? For today or for next week?
n4.deliverySL: [toplo] Izvolite. Pa še malo paradižnika? Za danes ali za čez teden?

n5explain.speaker: npc
n5explain.sl: Zreli so za danes, trdi pa za čez teden. Poglejte — tile ali tisti?
n5explain.en: Ripe ones are for today, firm ones for next week. Look — these or those?
n5explain.deliverySL: [toplo] Zreli so za danes, trdi pa za čez teden. Poglejte — tile ali tisti?

n5b.speaker: npc
n5b.sl: Tile so zreli — za danes. Tisti — za čez teden.
n5b.en: These are ripe — for today. Those — for next week.
n5b.deliverySL: [toplo] Tile so zreli — za danes. Tisti — za čez teden.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.en: There, weighed. Would you like anything else?

c6a.speaker: client
c6a.en: (pointing at the leeks) What's this called?

n7word.speaker: npc
n7word.sl: To je por. Por! Lepo, da sprašujete.
n7word.en: That's a leek — 'por'. Por! Nice that you ask.
n7word.deliverySL: [veselo] To je por. Por! Lepo, da sprašujete.

nMore.speaker: npc
nMore.sl: Izvolite, en por. Še kaj drugega?
nMore.en: Here you are, one leek. Anything else?
nMore.deliverySL: [toplo] Izvolite, en por. Še kaj drugega?

c8a.speaker: client
c8a.en: No, thanks. How much is it?

nPrice.speaker: npc
nPrice.sl: Da vidim … skupaj bo štiri evre dvajset. Pa naj vam tekne!
nPrice.en: Let me see … that's four euros twenty altogether. Enjoy it!
nPrice.deliverySL: [toplo] Da vidim … skupaj bo štiri evre dvajset. Pa naj vam tekne!

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Hvala vam! Pa kako lepo že govorite slovensko. Se vidiva prihodnjič!
nBye.en: Thank you! And how nicely you already speak Slovene. See you next time!
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala vam! Pa kako lepo že govorite slovensko. Se vidiva prihodnjič!

objectives.label: Ste tu vsak dan?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask about her — is she here every day, when is she here.

objectives.label: Je to vse za danes?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask whether that's all she has today.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Kar poglejte, kaj je še ostalo.
n1.en: Good day! Have a look at what's still left.
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! Kar poglejte, kaj je še ostalo.

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Pol kila jagod, prosim.
c1a.en: Good day. Half a kilo of strawberries, please.

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: No, thanks. How much is it?

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.en: Here you are. Are you here every day?

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.en: Here you are. Are you here every day?
c3b.context: she only comes in the mornings

c3c.speaker: client
c3c.sl: Izvolite. Je to vse za danes?
c3c.en: Here you are. Is that all for today?

n4daily.speaker: npc
n4daily.sl: Ja, vsak dan. Razen v nedeljo.
n4daily.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, vsak dan. Razen v nedeljo.

n4morn.speaker: npc
n4morn.en: Not all day — only in the mornings.

n5noon.speaker: npc
n5noon.en: Until noon. Then I pack up.

n4all.speaker: npc
n4all.sl: Ja, danes je šlo vse. Jutri imamo še več.
n4all.en: Yes, everything sold today. Tomorrow we'll have more.
n4all.deliverySL: [veselo] Ja, danes je šlo vse. Jutri imamo še več.

nSee.speaker: npc
nSee.sl: Potem pa pridite zgodaj. Zjutraj je najlepše.
nSee.en: Then come early. The mornings are the best.
nSee.deliverySL: [toplo] Potem pa pridite zgodaj. Zjutraj je najlepše.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Srečno, pa se še kaj oglasite!
nBye.en: All the best, and do drop by again!
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Srečno, pa se še kaj oglasite!

new.predictableError: Says *Vidim vas jutri* (a word-for-word 'I'll see you tomorrow'), which Slovenes don't use as a goodbye. The goodbye is *Pa do jutri* or *Se vidimo jutri*.

objectives.label: Cel nakup
objectives.descriptorEN: A whole visit with the complications stacked up — out of stock, a sour fruit, a repair, a price surprise — and a chat at the end.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Kdo je pa na vrsti? Vi? Kaj vam dam danes?
n1.en: Good day! Who's next? You? What can I get you today?
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! Kdo je pa na vrsti? Vi? Kaj vam dam danes?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.en: Good day. Do you have strawberries today?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: Good day. Do you have garlic today?

n2.speaker: npc

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: What else do you have today?

c2b.speaker: client

n3slow.speaker: npc

n3word.speaker: npc
n3word.sl: Blitva? Tole zeleno tukaj, glejte. Za juho je dobra.

n5.speaker: npc

c6b.speaker: client

c7a.speaker: client
c7a.sl: Ja, še jabolka, prosim. So sladka?

n7sour.speaker: npc

n8.speaker: npc

n8.en: Yes, they're ripe, and home-grown, from the Barje. How many shall I give you?
n8.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, zrele so, pa domače, z Barja. Koliko vam jih dam?

c9b.speaker: client

c9b.en: Two hundred grams, please. That's all.

nTotal.speaker: npc
nTotal.sl: Tako, to bo skupaj štirinajst osemdeset.
nTotal.en: Right, that'll be fourteen eighty altogether.
nTotal.deliverySL: [poslovno] Tako, to bo skupaj štirinajst osemdeset.

n10again.deliverySL: [toplo] Štirinajst evrov osemdeset. Tole je najdražje, glejte.

n11less.speaker: npc
n11less.sl: Ni problema, malo vzamem ven. Zdaj je dvanajst petdeset.
n11less.en: No problem, I'll take some out. Now it's twelve fifty.
n11less.deliverySL: [toplo] Ni problema, malo vzamem ven. Zdaj je dvanajst petdeset.

c13a.speaker: client
c13a.sl: Ja, imam, hvala. Ste tu vsak dan?
c13a.en: Yes, I do, thanks. Are you here every day?

c13b.speaker: client
c13b.sl: Ne. Je to vse za danes?
c13b.en: No. Is that all for today?

n13.speaker: npc
n13.sl: Ne vsak dan — od torka do sobote.
n13.en: Not every day — Tuesday to Saturday.
n13.deliverySL: [toplo] Ne vsak dan — od torka do sobote.

n14.speaker: npc
n14.sl: Zjutraj, od sedmih do poldneva. Pridite zgodaj, takrat je vse še sveže.
n14.en: In the mornings, from seven till noon. Come early, everything's still fresh then.
n14.deliverySL: [toplo] Zjutraj, od sedmih do poldneva. Pridite zgodaj, takrat je vse še sveže.

n13b.speaker: npc
n13b.sl: Izvolite, eno vrečko vam dam. Ja, sobota je, vse je šlo. Jutri … a ne, jutri nas ni. V torek bo spet polno.
n13b.en: Here, I'll give you a bag. Yes, it's Saturday, everything's gone. Tomorrow … oh no, we're not here tomorrow. On Tuesday it'll be full again.
n13b.deliverySL: [toplo] Izvolite, eno vrečko vam dam. Ja, sobota je, vse je šlo. Jutri … a ne, jutri nas ni. V torek bo spet polno.

cz2.speaker: client
cz2.en: Thank you very much. See you on Tuesday!

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Hvala vam! Lep vikend, pa se vidimo.
nBye.en: Thank you! Have a nice weekend, and see you.
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala vam! Lep vikend, pa se vidimo.

c7c.speaker: client
c7c.en: No, thanks. How much is it?
